items.name: Alert emails
items.what: Buttondown sends the alerts and the weekly roundup (Basic plan).

items.name: News check
items.what: An AI model (Claude) reads gaming news about once a day and suggests changes, and reads restock posts from one deals account on X when they show up. I approve every change. It's paid from a small prepaid balance with a daily limit, so it can't run up a bill.

items.name: Posts on X
items.what: X charges me about 2 cents for a post with no link in it (and $0.20 with one), so my posts there have no link and spell out the site's name instead. Reading the deals account's restock posts costs about half a cent each, capped at 100 posts every 10 days. Paid from a prepaid balance.
items.price: About 2 cents a post, plus up to about $1.50 a month for reading

items.name: Visit counts
items.what: Google Analytics. The privacy page says what it collects.
